title: VariableDefinitionRegistry
description: Canonical machine-readable variable registry contract for clinical tabular research, operationalization, and data leakage prevention

study_id.description: Identifier of the research study or paper (e.g., Paper_01_NHANES_NoLab)

dataset.description: Primary dataset name or family (e.g., NHANES, BRFSS, MIMIC-IV)

registry_version.description: Semantic version or date-stamped revision of this variable registry

canonical_name.description: Standardized canonical variable name in snake_case (e.g., age_years, fasting_glucose_mg_dl)

role.description: Primary epidemiological and modeling role of the variable

prediction_horizon.description: Prediction horizon for predictive outcomes per AGENTS.md §3b

source_bindings.description: Source variable bindings across dataset releases or survey cycles

source_name.description: Exact column or field name in the raw dataset file (e.g., RIDAGEYR, LBXGLU)

source_label.description: Verbatim descriptive label from raw codebook or dataset metadata

type.description: Type of reference (e.g., codebook, questionnaire, laboratory_procedure_manual, clinical_guideline, publication, project_frozen_definition)

title.description: Title or descriptive label of the authoritative source document

url_or_identifier.description: Direct URL, DOI, or accession identifier for the documentation

location.description: Exact section, table, question ID, or variable entry in the document

accessed_or_verified_date.description: ISO-8601 date when the documentation was accessed or verified

availability.description: Availability relative to decision or index time t0

index_time_definition.description: Explicit definition of index time t0 for this variable

measurement_window.description: Temporal measurement window relative to index time (e.g., baseline exam, 12 months prior to t0)

source_unit.description: Raw measurement unit documented in source codebook

analysis_unit.description: Standardized measurement unit used in statistical analysis or modeling

conversion.description: Mathematical formula, conversion factor, or null if source_unit matches analysis_unit

source_codes.description: Raw category values and descriptions from source codebook

analysis_mapping.description: Explicit mapping of source codes to analysis levels/values

source_missing_codes.description: List of explicit integer or string sentinel codes denoting non-response, refusal, or unmeasured

structural_missingness.description: True if missingness is due to legitimate skip patterns or questionnaire branching

skip_pattern.description: Documented questionnaire filter or skip condition explaining structural absence

planned_handling.description: Planned pipeline handling strategy (e.g., complete_case, fold_safe_median_impute, encode_as_zero_with_indicator)

is_derived.description: True if variable is computed or derived from other variables

formula_or_rule.description: Exact mathematical formula or logical rule used to derive the variable

components.description: List of canonical variable names required to compute this derived variable

status.description: Verification status of the variable definition

evidence.description: Authoritative evidence sources verifying the definition

conflicts.description: Documented discrepancies or conflicts between sources requiring resolution

reason.description: Clinical and methodological rationale supporting the leakage determination

is_clinical_score.description: True if this variable represents an established clinical risk score

score_name.description: Name of official score (e.g., FINDRISC, ADA Diabetes Risk Test)

official_reference.description: Citation or DOI of the published score specification

reproduction_fidelity.description: Degree of fidelity to the official score definition

unmapped_components.description: List of official score components that could not be mapped in this dataset
